panels.title: Cumulative Part Risk Scores over Time

targets.query:
from(bucket: "factory_telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "part_risk" and r._field == "cumulative_risk")
  |> yield(name: "risk")

from(bucket: "factory_telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "part_risk" and r._field == "cumulative_risk" and r._value > 0.5)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "part_id", "current_station", "risk_level", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "risk_score"})
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 25)
